connect.featureTeam: Team roles, workspaces, and SSO on Team
connect.fastmailHintOauth: Recommended. Your browser will redirect to Fastmail to authorize access.
connect.fastmailHintAppPassword: Generate a Fastmail app password in account settings. Your main password is never used.
connect.genericHint: Connect any mailbox that supports IMAP and SMTP.
connect.zohoRegionHint: Find this in Zoho → Settings → Mail Accounts if you are unsure.
connect.usernamePlaceholder: Leave blank to use your email address
connect.usernameHint: Only needed if your provider uses a separate login username instead of your email address. Check your provider's mail settings (e.g. "Username" or "Account name").
connect.passwordHint: Use your mailbox password. If your provider has 2-step verification (e.g. Gmail, Outlook, iCloud), generate an app password instead. The credential is encrypted before storage.
connect.verificationWarningTitle: Before you connect: app verification in progress
connect.verificationWarningReview: mcpemails.com is currently in Google's verification and CASA security-assessment review. This is expected while the review completes.
connect.verificationWarningGoogleScreen: Google will show a “Google hasn’t verified this app” screen. To continue, click “Advanced”, then “Go to mcpemails.com (unsafe)”.
connect.verificationWarningOutlookScreen: Microsoft may show an “unverified publisher” consent warning. Review the permissions and click “Accept” to continue.
connect.verificationWarningReauth: While in review, the connection's access expires roughly every 7 days, so you'll need to reconnect this inbox periodically.
